Subject: Approval Request: Six-Week Invoice Handling Pilot

Hi Morgan,

I’m writing to propose moving forward with the approved six-week pilot to assess invoice handling.

The pilot is designed to evaluate whether the process can support the client’s goal of reducing handling time by 20%. While no baseline or measured savings has been established, the pilot will provide a focused opportunity to assess performance before considering any broader commitment.

The proposed fee is a fixed $30,000 for the six-week pilot. Production rollout is explicitly excluded from this scope.

To proceed, we need your approval of the pilot scope and fee, subject to security clearance. Security approval will be required before any access to client data can begin, and no start date has yet been approved.

Please confirm whether you approve the pilot scope and $30,000 fixed fee, contingent on security approval.

Best,  
Jordan  
Engagement Lead
